Burner phone.name: Burner phone
Burner phone.description: A cheap prepaid phone with a number tied to no real name. Japanese law requires ID for every phone contract and bans handing phones on without the carrier's consent, so it comes from a broker who breaks that law. It is for calls that must not lead back to its owner, and it gets thrown away the moment they might. [ Tool | About ¥10,000 ]
